data.name: Specialty Tour: Charlie Gibson's Queer Boston
data.headline: Guided Museum Tour • 60 mins • Ages 12+
data.description:
Explore the Gibson House and early-twentieth-century Boston through Charlie Gibson's eyes! The story of the museum's founder is one of legacy and family history; of the fading grandeur of Victorian-era Boston; and of the role gay men, like Charlie, had in the historic preservation movement. This unique specialty house tour is not to be missed! 

Each tour involves walking up and down several flights of stairs. The Gibson House is not air-conditioned.

Regular and specialty tours are also available for private groups by appointment.

meeting_point.address: The Gibson House Museum, 137 Beacon Street, Boston

data.cancellation_notes: Reservations are nontransferable and nonrefundable. Customers will receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

You can explore more through our program offerings at www.thegibsonhouse.org/events. Enjoy your tour!
